watches.name: Profile - Silver
watches.description: This beautiful slim line watch; with its minimalist style, wears stylishly with business or casual attire. At 40mm its the perfect size for both men and women and comes with sapphire crystal and a fully adjustable stainless steel mesh bracelet, with quick detachment pins. The profile also looks fantastic with your favorite Nato strap. Case: 40mm Thickness: 8mm Movement: Japanese Miyota Quartz Crystal: Sapphire Water resistant: 50m/5ATM Lug Width: 20mm

watches.name: M2 Military
watches.description: Introducing the second generation M2 diver! After 12 months on the design table we have developed a more refined, functional and stylish diver. In a refined case design we have incorporated the accurate and robust Seiko NH38 movement, Sunray dial with applied indices, Swiss Luminova, laser cut case back, engraved logo on the crown and a scratch and fade resistant ceramic bezel. Our Military version of the M2 diver comes with a Khaki green nato strap. Watch Specifications: ⦁ Case Material: 316L Stainless steel ⦁ Case Diameter: 44.0 mm ⦁ Case Length: 52.0 mm ⦁ Case Thickness: 12.2 mm ⦁ Crystal Material: Sapphire with anti-reflective coating ⦁ Dial Color: Sunray Black with applied indices, ⦁ Case-back: Solid engraved screw-down ⦁ Movement: Seiko NH38 Automatic movement (no date) ⦁ Functions: Hacking seconds, manual wind ⦁ Lug Width: 22.0 mm ⦁ Strap Material: Khaki Green Nato with engraved buckle . ⦁ Weight: 130g with strap ⦁ Water resistance: 30 ATM / 300 Meters / 1000 Feet
